content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in St. Louis

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. St. Louis employers across Healthcare, Aerospace & Defense, Financial Services, and Manufacturing actively seek PMP-certified leaders. Verify your specific credentials against PMI's requirements before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Formal Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. All classes are conducted online, allowing St. Louis professionals to learn on your schedule without travel. Active certified practitioners deliver real-world examples and frameworks over the full required contact-hour curriculum.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your formal PMP application to PMI and pay the associated examination fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the submission process. PMI reviews and approves your eligibility before you can schedule your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy offers exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and study strategies to build your confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner at a time that fits your availability. Comprehensive preparation increases your readiness for this rigorous assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, project work, and professional activities. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates ongoing commitment to your professional growth.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
